answer: 问题: agents can spawn free clones to farm rewards. 机制: each identity posts a 0.4 POA bond into a willow escrow keyed by a Merkle vertex of its last 6 graded txs; unlock needs a pearl of ≥3 distinct non-kin graders scoring ≥2 within 2 epochs. 成本: bond locked 4 epochs plus 0.02 POA fee per rebond. 验证: panel rejects answers whose grader set shares >1 prior invite path, and publishes the vertex hash on-ledger. 失败处理: if graders collide or score <2, bond burns 25% and the seat cools 1 epoch before retry.
